differs: The model column is usually the routing label agent; TokenTracker replaces it with a model from the .chat timeline (nearest window within 10 min), which we do not read. tokscale estimates chars/4 from .chat and execution snapshots instead of reading dev_data, so its totals are much lower. Rows are one request each: tokens_prompt is the whole prompt with no cache split.
